summary: Frontend-only verification of two new features (mic selector + playlist save/import multi-file). All targeted flows pass: MicSelector renders in the header, lists available audioinput devices, and persists selection to localStorage key 'hotlive95_mic_device' (selecting a device stores its id, selecting 'Default microphone' clears it). No enumerateDevices/getUserMedia crashes. import-playlist-input has the 'multiple' attribute and accepts .hl95playlist/.hl95playout/.json. Save-playlist button is present per-playlist (disabled correctly when 0 tracks). App loads cleanly under license seed, no console errors or page errors.
critical_code_review_comments: MicSelector requests getUserMedia({audio:true}) on mount just to reveal labels — this triggers a mic permission prompt as soon as the app is loaded on real devices; consider deferring to first dropdown open to avoid surprising the DJ.

In App.js savePlaylistFile the ~40MB split relies on estimated base64 track size; consider hard capping computed part size to leave headroom for JSON overhead so exported parts never exceed provider upload limits (edge case).
